description: This file is a shell script used for building, testing, and packaging the TensorFlow Python pip package. It includes environment setup, build commands with Bazel, tests within virtual environments, and handling of wheel files. It also manages platform-specific configurations and optional GPU/ROCm support.

methods.name: test_pip_virtualenv
methods.description: Performs pip installation in a virtual environment, runs a basic tensorflow import test, and optionally runs bazel tests.

methods.name: create_activate_virtualenv
methods.description: Creates, activates, and deactivates a virtual environment for testing purposes.

methods.name: install_tensorflow_pip
methods.description: Installs a TensorFlow pip wheel into the virtual environment and sets up necessary dependencies.

methods.name: run_test_with_bazel
methods.description: Runs bazel tests on specified targets, with environment and filter configurations.

methods.name: run_all_tests
methods.description: Runs a series of specified pip tests and reports the results.
